Class Industry

java.lang.Object
domain.Industry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Industry extends Object implements Serializable
Represents an industry in the railway system. Each industry has a specific type, position on the map, cargo generation amount, and storage capacity for different types of resources. This class is used to manage industries that can generate and consume different types of cargo in the system.
